connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Suggested Domains
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Suggested Domains data connector ingests suggested domains: candidate domains related to your monitored organizations that may belong to you but are not yet monitored (they are review candidates, not proof of ownership) from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.description: Latest FullHunt Suggested Domains records (deduplicated by SuggestedDomain)
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntSuggestedDomains_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SuggestedDomain
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

FullHuntSuggestedDomains_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SuggestedDomain
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: FullHuntSuggestedDomains_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntSuggestedDomains_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt Suggested Domains to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt every 15 minutes.
